name: Copper/Gold Ratio as SPY Leading Indicator
description: Research study analyzing whether the copper/gold ratio leads SPY equity gains. Computes the HG/GC continuous futures ratio, its 60-day rate of change, and the forward 20-day SPY return. Outputs: (1) scatter of C/G 60d ROC vs SPY fwd 20d return with OLS trend line, (2) rolling 60d correlation between the two series over time, (3) summary table comparing avg fwd return, hit rate, and observation count when the ratio is rising (ROC > 0) vs falling (ROC < 0).
source:
# =============================================================================
# COPPER/GOLD RATIO AS SPY LEADING INDICATOR
# =============================================================================
# Hypothesis: Rising copper/gold ratio (risk-on commodity signal) leads
#             positive SPY equity returns over the next 20 trading days.
#
# Event signal : 60-day ROC of HG/GC ratio  (ratio >> 60 as lookback)
# Forward window: 20 trading days (SPY close << 20)
# Rollover      : NoAdjustment — cross-commodity ratio requires raw prices
#                 to preserve true price relationships across contracts
# =============================================================================

# --- Primary data source (HG copper futures) ---
hg_src = market_data_source()()

# --- Reference futures: Gold (GC) ---
gc_ref = reference_futures(ticker='GC')()

# --- Copper continuation (NoAdjustment: ratio analysis needs raw prices) ---
hg_cont = futures_continuation(
    s_rollover_method=RolloverType.FirstOfMonth,
    s_adjustment_method=AdjustmentType.NoAdjustment
)(hg_src.o, hg_src.h, hg_src.l, hg_src.c, hg_src.v, hg_src.oi, hg_src.s)

# --- Gold continuation (NoAdjustment: same reason) ---
gc_cont = futures_continuation(
    s_rollover_method=RolloverType.FirstOfMonth,
    s_adjustment_method=AdjustmentType.NoAdjustment
)(gc_ref.o, gc_ref.h, gc_ref.l, gc_ref.c, gc_ref.v, gc_ref.oi, gc_ref.s)

# Forward-fill both to handle any roll-day gaps
hg_close = ffill(hg_cont.c)
gc_close = ffill(gc_cont.c)

# --- SPY reference (reindexed to HG calendar) ---
spy_src = common_reference_stocks(ticker=ReferenceStock.SPY)()
spy_close = ffill(spy_src.c)

# =============================================================================
# COPPER/GOLD RATIO & 60-DAY ROC
# =============================================================================

# Raw ratio: copper price / gold price
cg_ratio = hg_close / gc_close

# 60-day rate of change on the ratio
# (ratio_today / ratio_60_bars_ago) - 1
cg_roc_60d = (cg_ratio / (cg_ratio >> 60)) - 1.0

# =============================================================================
# FORWARD 20-DAY SPY RETURN
# =============================================================================

# Forward return: what SPY does over the NEXT 20 trading days
spy_fwd_20d = (spy_close << 20) / spy_close - 1.0

# =============================================================================
# ROLLING 60-DAY CORRELATION (ROC vs Forward Return)
# =============================================================================

roll_corr_60d = rolling_corr(
    window=60,
    window_type=WindowType.rolling,
    method=CorrelationMethod.pearson
)(x=cg_roc_60d, y=spy_fwd_20d)

idx = index()

# =============================================================================
# REGIME CLASSIFICATION: RATIO RISING vs FALLING
# =============================================================================

is_rising  = cg_roc_60d > 0.0   # Copper/gold ratio trending up (risk-on)
is_falling = cg_roc_60d < 0.0   # Copper/gold ratio trending down (risk-off)

# Filter forward returns by regime
spy_fwd_rising  = where(is_rising,  spy_fwd_20d)
spy_fwd_falling = where(is_falling, spy_fwd_20d)

# Hit rate: 1.0 when SPY fwd return is positive, null otherwise (for Count)
spy_hit_rising  = where(is_rising  and (spy_fwd_20d > 0.0), spy_fwd_20d)
spy_hit_falling = where(is_falling and (spy_fwd_20d > 0.0), spy_fwd_20d)

# =============================================================================
# REPORTS
# =============================================================================

# --- Chart 1: Scatter — C/G 60d ROC vs SPY Forward 20d Return ---
xy_scatter(
    title='Copper/Gold 60-Day ROC vs SPY Forward 20-Day Return',
    category='Copper/Gold Leading Indicator',
    x_axis_label='C/G Ratio 60-Day ROC',
    y_axis_label='SPY Forward 20-Day Return',
    x_axis_format=AxisValueFormat.PercentFormat,
    x_axis_dp=1,
    y_axis_format=AxisValueFormat.PercentFormat,
    y_axis_dp=1,
    series=ScatterSeriesSchema(series=[
        ScatterSeriesSpec(name='SPY Fwd 20d Return', color=Color.Blue, marker=MarkerSymbol.CircleMarker)
    ]),
    reference_lines=ReferenceLineSchema(lines=[
        ReferenceLine(value=0, title='Zero Return', color=Color.Gray, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash)
    ]),
    show_trend_line=True,
    order=0
)(x=cg_roc_60d, y_values=(spy_fwd_20d,))

# --- Chart 2: Rolling 60d Correlation over time ---
xy_lines(
    title='Rolling 60-Day Correlation: C/G ROC vs SPY Fwd Return',
    category='Copper/Gold Leading Indicator',
    y_axis_label='Rolling 60d Pearson Correlation',
    y_axis_format=AxisValueFormat.DecimalFormat,
    y_axis_dp=2,
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name='60d Correlation', color=Color.Blue)
    ]),
    reference_lines=ReferenceLineSchema(lines=[
        ReferenceLine(value=0,    title='Zero',        color=Color.Slate, dash_style=DashStyle.Solid),
        ReferenceLine(value=0.3,  title='+0.30',       color=Color.Teal,  dash_style=DashStyle.Dot),
        ReferenceLine(value=-0.3, title='-0.30',       color=Color.Orange, dash_style=DashStyle.Dot)
    ]),
    order=1
)(idx, roll_corr_60d)

# --- Summary Table: Regime Comparison ---
# Rows: Rising ratio (ROC > 0) | Falling ratio (ROC < 0)
# Cols: Avg Fwd SPY Return | Hit Rate (% positive) | Observations
#
# Pattern: reuse the where()-filtered series for both Count and Mean
# Count = number of non-null bars = observation count per regime
# Mean  = average forward return per regime
# Hit rate = Count(positive hits) / Count(all regime bars) — shown as Mean of hit series
summary_table(
    layout=SummaryTableLayout(
        title='SPY Forward 20d Return by Copper/Gold Regime',
        row_size=2,
        col_size=3,
        row_headers=['Ratio Rising (ROC > 0)', 'Ratio Falling (ROC < 0)'],
        col_headers=['Avg Fwd SPY Return', 'Hit Rate (% +ve)', 'Observations'],
        cells=[
            # Row 0: Rising regime
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean,  type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2, grid_color=Color.Teal),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Count, type=CardRenderType.IntegerFormat),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=2, grid_agg=AggregationType.Count, type=CardRenderType.IntegerFormat, grid_color=Color.Teal),
            # Row 1: Falling regime
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=1, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean,  type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2, grid_color=Color.Orange),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=1, grid_col=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Count, type=CardRenderType.IntegerFormat),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=1, grid_col=2, grid_agg=AggregationType.Count, type=CardRenderType.IntegerFormat, grid_color=Color.Orange)
        ]
    ),
    category='Copper/Gold Leading Indicator',
    order=2
)(spy_fwd_rising, spy_hit_rising, spy_fwd_rising, spy_fwd_falling, spy_hit_falling, spy_fwd_falling)
